concepts: phase III randomized controlled trial fecal microbiota transplantation immune checkpoint inhibitor solid tumor
gap.question: Are there any completed large-scale Phase III randomized controlled trials of microbiome interventions in ICI-treated solid tumour patients?
success_criteria: Identification of a completed Phase III RCT with published primary outcome data on efficacy (OS/PFS/ORR).
gap.user_scope: How does the gut microbiome modulate the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in solid tumours, and what mechanisms mediate that effect?
